Maya: ok real talk 120,000,000 monthly requests 🎉🎉🎉
Omar: WHAT. that number!!! holy cow. congrats team :tada: :rocket:
Lin: midnight pho and plushies? i'm half serious.
Sasha: plushie idea: a tiny server with a cape. who doesn't want that on their desk. :smile_cat:
Ravi: tiny cape server plushie is peak branding. also can we do a confetti cannon in the SF office? low risk?
Maya: poll: react 1 = in-person confetti, 2 = snack spread + karaoke, 3 = remote care packages with plushie
Omar: remote people matter. care packages pls. last time the stickers vanished in 2 hours. :eyes:
Lin: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/party-team-3o6Zt8MgUuvSbkZ3mI "perfect"
Sasha: cost check @OpsBot — ballpark for 150 care packages (plushie + snack + sticker)?
OpsBot: Sasha asked for budget estimate. FinanceOps channel notified. Typical care package cost range: $18-$35 per package depending on plushie size and shipping.
Ravi: if we keep it lean maybe $22 avg. get smaller plushies and a locally-sourced snack. also include a handwritten note?
Maya: love the handwritten note idea. small ask: everyone who wants a package DM me address by Wed EOD.
Omar: also can someone volunteer to run a 10-min "rooftop shoutouts" on Friday? i can emcee if needed.
Lin: i'll DJ. i have a playlist called "latency bangers".
Sasha: sample ops command for ordering swag I stole from another thread:
```
/create-swag-order --item plushie-server-small --qty 150 --include sticker-pack --ship-by 2026-04-09
```
Maya: schedule: ship by Thu, virtual toast Friday 6pm PT (so EU can join).
Ravi: timezone math check: 6pm PT = 2am CET. rough but doable for volunteers. maybe record?
Omar: record + send care packages earlier so EU teammates still feel included during toast.
Sasha: kudos thread time 1: who made the infra magic this month? drop one-line shoutouts
Lin: huge kudos to @Ravi for the monitoring dashboards. real-time charts saved our sanity.
Ravi: thanks!! shoutout to @Lin for the deployment scripts cleanup. fewer manual steps = nicer souls.
Maya: i'm blushing. will compile all kudos for the all-hands slide.
OpsBot: automated note: no critical incidents during the surge window. scheduling maintenance as requested: none this weekend.
Maya: ok that's it. party planning channel incoming. good night and don't let the plushies haunt you. :sleeping:
